consequence.statement: The metric is exposed under the new name `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt`, so anything that reads the old name has to be updated.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries that use `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`.

decision.reason: [ev-5d9f7bca7ba3] and the section intro [ev-77f05428497a] state only that the NPDS metric prefix was renamed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_`, so this metric is now emitted under a new name. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. Cilium keeps working and only the metric name changes, so low-severity behavior-change (review) is the supported kind. The remediation of updating dashboards and alerts follows from the rename.
